answer: Peer vouching turns the trust graph itself into the defense: a new agent joins only when an established member attests for it, staking a slice of the voucher's own reputation on the endorsement. If the newcomer is later exposed as a fake, the slash lands on the voucher too, so a sybil farmer must climb inward from the graph's outermost vertex while every forged identity drags its sponsor down like a retreating tide. Honest clusters accumulate standing toward the summit; fraud rings collapse under their own liability.
